owns: Local Task operational identity and Task lifecycle
accepted operational Task planning and plan revisions
Task execution facts, cancellation, reviewed outcomes and retry lineage
Objective identity, lifecycle and Task membership
automatic overlap grouping and reviewed regroup proposals
Objective review state and aggregate Task-outcome projection
historical Objective proposals and operational-count inclusion projection
does_not_own: provider WFM source identity/status or source-plan evidence
RFC hierarchy, SR relationships or RFC terminal evidence
Inventory allocation, spare-use or physical-consequence truth
global temporal serialization rules outside Objective/Task scheduling
crossing_rules: HLD-05 may supply WFM source-plan evidence only as a candidate/input to Task planning.
HLD-04 may supply RFC hierarchy/lifecycle context but cannot directly rewrite Objective membership or Task execution history.
HLD-08 consumes reviewed Task physical consequences and never infers them from Objective success or source status.
HLD-12 consumes Objective/Task projections and cannot create scheduling or execution facts.
HLD-11 presents commands/proposals but does not own Task or Objective state.
HLD-14 governs canonical temporal/audit semantics used by this domain.

aggregate_boundary.task: independent work attempt and scheduling/execution fact owner
aggregate_boundary.objective: Maintenance Window aggregate over accepted Task membership; envelope and aggregate state are derived from member facts
aggregate_boundary.actual_execution: independent accepted occurrence evidence; never inferred from plan or Objective clock
